# QMD Query and Maintenance for Ultimate Wiki

## Query expectations
The Ultimate Wiki should support:
- lexical lookup
- metadata filtering
- link/backlink exploration
- graph-oriented traversal
- session/chronicle recall
- source-family-aware retrieval

## Maintenance expectations
- frontmatter discipline
- link density
- summary presence
- provenance/freshness tracking
- orphan reduction
- inbox/capture triage
- archive and demotion paths

## Why
The old vault was powerful partly because it had metabolism.
The new wiki should too.
